abstract: This study examines the relationship between occupational exposure to artificial intelligence and unemployment risk. The research finds that workers in AI-exposed occupations experience significantly higher unemployment risk compared to those in less-exposed occupations, suggesting that AI adoption is creating meaningful labor market disruption across specific job categories.
keyFindings: Workers in AI-exposed occupations face significantly higher unemployment risk
Occupational AI exposure is a measurable predictor of unemployment outcomes
